name: Union on San Antonio

footprint._src: S1 verbatim. In (u,v) the four corners are (104.16,0.00) (104.11,35.76) (0.00,35.78) (0.03,0.00) - the polygon IS its own oriented bounding box, so every edge is axis-parallel in the frame.

_frame_src: S1 and S8 retained. Local +u south, +v east; north-west site corner is the height datum.
_readme: Union on San Antonio. Offset two-wing shape, balcony columns, alternating dark/pale long faces, corner amenities and entry derived from reference photographs. Metric dimensions remain approximate.

sources.S1: data/snapshots/2026-08-27/buildings.detailed.geojson feature 87f9cf87-79b7-46e5-803c-2936c8d98fbf: name 'Union on San Antonio', num_floors null, final_height 7.4, source_height 'overture', building_class 'apartments'. The footprint is a clean 4-vertex rectangle; in metres it is 104.16 x 35.78 m (3,724 m2), long axis at bearing 185.3 deg. The 7.4 m is Overture's guess for a building OSM never tagged with a height and it is absurd for a 29-storey tower: it is OVERRIDDEN here by S3.
sources.S2: OSM way 380922462: building=apartments, name 'Union on San Antonio', addr 2011 San Antonio Street, Austin, TX 78705, source 'City of Austin', check_date 2024-09-22. NO height, NO building:levels, NO building:part - queried through Overpass 2026-09-07. Nothing about this building's shape is in OSM.
sources.S3: SkyscraperPage building page b119740, 'Union on San Antonio, Austin', its numbers quoted as coming from building elevations: mechanical roof parapet 332 ft (101.19 m), roof 332 ft, top floor 292 ft (89.0 m), 29 storeys, residential with parking garage, construction 2022-2024. The 332 ft is what levels.roof + parapet is solved to exactly.
sources.S8: data/roads.geojson: West 21st Street runs east-west through (-97.743018, 30.283878) and (-97.741944, 30.283803), immediately north of the footprint's north edge, and San Antonio Street runs north-south along its west edge. That is what fixes which end of the obb is which, and it agrees with S5's 'the corner of San Antonio Street and W 21st Street'.
sources.S10: Esri World Imagery MapServer/export retrieved 2026-09-12; bboxSR=imageSR=4326; returned extent [-97.74395,30.28215,-97.74165,30.28445], size 1200x1200. Construction floorplate has two approximately 52m-long wings, about 20m wide, offset east-west with a central overlap. It occupies almost the full 104m site length. The earlier 31m square model contradicts this view. The model uses derived axes u 1.6..102 and v 1.9..33.5, a west cutout south of u 55 and an east cutout north of u 47. Setbacks retain about 2m uncertainty because aerial perspective and construction edges are not a survey.

open: Slab roof94m and central roof-block top97.5m are a photo-fit hypothesis above the northwest ground datum. The public101.19m mechanical/parapet height has no confirmed matching datum.
Twenty-one balcony slabs are directly countable in the clearest long view; lower rows are obscured. The23-row tower module and3.06m repeat remain inferred.
North/east metric camera calibration is unresolved; visible features are modeled, but those elevations are not independently shape-validated.
App ground is flat while the street slopes about4m across the site. Entry/garage locations and the lower storey extents have metre-scale uncertainty.
Unseen inner return surfaces repeat the nearest observed treatment. Roof equipment and unseen terrace furnishings are omitted.
Public construction evidence S10 supports plan topology; precise final setbacks remain approximate.
